preprocessing.source_files: original TIFF/BMP; read only; one prediction per file; no augmentation
preprocessing.decode: Pillow Image.open -> convert RGB; no explicit EXIF transpose or ICC conversion
preprocessing.rgb: decoded original RGB; no preliminary JPEG recompression
preprocessing.ela: at native resolution: abs(RGB - decoded JPEG(RGB,q=85))*10; clip[0,255]; uint8
preprocessing.q_ela_selection: fixed before external predictions, within training grid [65,70,75,80,85,90,95,100]
preprocessing.both_inputs: PIL Resize((224,224), bilinear, antialias=True) -> ToTensor -> Normalize

protocol.feature_fusion_v2: [RGB_512, ELA_512] -> saved MLP; frozen identical backbones; eval mode

calibration_source.selection: macro-F1 with total REAL weight 0.5 and total FAKE weight 0.5

protocol.metric_weighting: ordinary unweighted metrics, one row per original file
limitations: Original Columbia TIFF/BMP is a distribution shift from CASIA JPEG-augmented PNG inputs.
q_ela=85 is a fixed protocol choice within the historical training grid, not an externally optimized setting.
Thresholds were selected on prepared CASIA validation pairs, not on Columbia or on a raw-file validation set.
Common CASIA validation membership is conditional on retained training code; checkpoints contain no split metadata.
Historical Feature Fusion V2 checkpoint selection retains the documented RGB validation-exposure limitation.
363 files are not 363 proven independent source photographs: authentic crops can share scenes and splices share donors.
Exact byte/pixel duplicate counts do not establish independence; donor/scene groups and cross-dataset visual duplicates are not audited.
No confidence interval or significance claim is made without a defensible independent-source grouping.
If Columbia results inform later changes, Columbia becomes development evidence; IMD2020 remains unexamined here.
